items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: I started coming to rehearsals and standing right there, he says, “Son get back you’re standing in the way,” you know?

ctx.x: Well just tell me something. Did you get a chance to get any, just a taste of Louis Armstrong playing with Lil Armstrong and the boys that came, the fellas that came from New Orleans?

Well I was with the fellas when they were in rehearsal, and I came out when he had the Hot Five with the Kid Ory, with the Kid Ory in there. And I started coming to rehearsals and standing right there, he says, “Son get back you’re standing in the way,” you know? But that was my impression, that was my introduction to show business. I’m listening, about 5:30 in the morning I’m delivering my newspapers down by that Sunset Cafe, and I’d look in the window at 5:30 in the morning and I’ve got my paper sack on my…
